name: Origami
oneLiner: Manage campaigns, edit follow-up delays, and run outreach tasks in Origami.
description: Origami runs your outbound. Ask how last night went and what is waiting on you, pause or resume a campaign, change a follow-up's timing, find a lead and stop messaging them, read or redraft the reply Origami wrote to a lead, and start a build of a new campaign or a background task for longer work, then check on that task later. Anything that needs your OK asks first, and replies are sent from Origami's Inbox. Autopilot's plays live on the separate Origami Autopilot app. Requires an administrator of an Origami primary organization on a paid plan with API access, connected by signing in. Existing campaign edits currently cover follow-up delays; changing campaign message copy is not supported by these tools.
status: Prepared, not submitted; live gates pending
